claims.claim_text: The indexed James F. Brousseau is confirmed as the Army entrant represented by the exact-name and private-identifier match in the official merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The full name and private service identifier match across the OSS index and official Army-entry file; the identifier is withheld.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by an exact private identifier and exact normalized full name.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army-entry record is dated May 8, 1942; the index documents an OSS personnel file but not the OSS transfer date.
claims.match_notes: Common-name, obituary, directory, genealogy, and modern professional results were rejected because they lacked the private identifier or Box 83 linkage.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry, James F. Brousseau was recorded in the civilian occupation category 'carpenters.'
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official record carries code 525; the official numerical list maps 5-25 to carpenters.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact private identifier and full indexed name.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded to Army entry on May 8, 1942; its relation to OSS recruitment remains unknown.
claims.match_notes: No employer, construction firm, worksite, specialty, or immediate OSS predecessor is inferred from the grouped code.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index and official Army merged file agree on James F. Brousseau's exact normalized name and private identifier. The identifier remains withheld; the Army row dates entry to May 8, 1942 and carries civilian occupation code 525.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 83 for a named employer, carpentry details, and Army-to-OSS chronology.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index and official Army merged file agree on Alvin Brower's exact name and private identifier. The Army row dates entry to April 17, 1943 but carries uninterpreted occupation code 999. A specialist roster separately places a T/5 Alvin Brower on the OSS Roanoke mission in Italy.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 83 for occupation, employer, and the Army-to-OSS sequence; code 999 remains uninterpreted.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index identifies Abraham Brown as a second lieutenant with a private officer identifier and Box 83. person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 83 for full name, unit, hometown, civilian work, and Army-to-OSS chronology.
